propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing four-character prefixes to remain locally salient in agent workflows
the summary schema and library/MCP/CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, preventing agents from discovering resolved aliases for tracker commands
agent guidance lacks an affirmative selection rule distinguishing when to use aliases for tracker commands versus canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts
pinned behavioral evaluation confirmed that adding resolved alias to local summary results independently produces 25/25 alias-based commands compared to 25/25 four-character prefixes without aliases
repair adds exact resolved alias as an additive field on every resolvable summary result while preserving ticket_id echo and fail-closed ambiguous-prefix semantics
